About the Authors

关于作者

Juan Pablo Buriticá knows what it takes to build and scale distributed engineering teams that thrive—whether at fast-moving startups or public companies. As he writes this book, he leads global technology at Convergint as CTO. He has built product engineering teams at Stripe and Splice, always focused on technical excellence and strong team culture. Beyond his work in the industry, he has helped bootstrap the tech community in Colombia and across Latin America through conferences, meetups, and continuous community advocacy, including founding one of the largest Spanish-speaking JavaScript collectives.

Juan Pablo Buriticá 深知，无论在高速迭代的创业公司还是在上市公司，打造并扩张一支能茁壮成长的分布式工程团队需要什么。撰写本书时，他以 CTO 身份执掌 Convergint 的全球技术团队。此前他曾在 Stripe 和 Splice 搭建产品工程团队，始终专注于技术卓越与强健的团队文化。在行业工作之外，他还通过会议、线下聚会和持续的社区推动，帮助哥伦比亚乃至整个拉丁美洲的科技社区从零起步，包括创立了最大的西班牙语 JavaScript 社区之一。

James Turnbull is CTO at Smartrr, an ecommerce startup focusing on subscriptions and postsale experiences for customers and merchants. Before Smartrr, he was SVP of Engineering at Sotheby’s, ran startup advocacy at Microsoft, and was founder and CTO at Empatico, CTO at Kickstarter, VP of Engineering at Venmo, and in leadership roles at Glitch, Docker, Timber, and Puppet. He also had a long career in enterprise technology, working in banking, biotech, and ecommerce. He chaired the O’Reilly Velocity conference series, is a startup advisor and investor, and has written 11 technical books.

James Turnbull 现任 Smartrr CTO——这是一家专注于订阅制与售后体验的电商创业公司，服务客户与商家。加入 Smartrr 之前，他曾任苏富比工程高级副总裁、在微软负责创业公司生态推广，并历任 Empatico 创始人兼 CTO、Kickstarter CTO、Venmo 工程 VP，以及 Glitch、Docker、Timber、Puppet 的领导职务。他在企业科技领域也有长期经历，涉足银行、生物科技和电商。他曾任 O’Reilly Velocity 大会系列主席，是创业公司顾问与投资人，并著有 11 本技术书籍。

Colophon

版本说明

The animal on the cover of Engineering Leadership: The Hard Parts is the emu (Dromaius novaehollandiae). Native to Australia, it’s best known for its height and inability to fly. As the third-tallest bird in the world, it can grow up to 1.9 meters (6 feet 3 inches). Its wings are considered vestigial, but it does sometimes flap them to stabilize itself when running, at speeds of up to 48 kilometers (or 30 miles) per hour.

《工程领导力：硬功夫》封面上的动物是鸸鹋（Dromaius novaehollandiae）。它原产于澳大利亚，以个子高大却不会飞而闻名。作为世界上第三高的鸟类，它可以长到 1.9 米（6 英尺 3 英寸）。它的翅膀被认为是退化器官，但奔跑时确实会扇动翅膀来保持平衡——奔跑时速可达 48 公里（约 30 英里）。

Its diet is omnivorous—insects, vegetation, flowers, fruits, and more. Since emus don’t have teeth, they also sometimes swallow small rocks to help grind the food into smaller pieces in their gizzard. They can go for long stretches without eating or drinking.

它是杂食性动物——昆虫、植物、花、果实等等都吃。由于鸸鹋没有牙齿，它们有时会吞下小石子，帮助在砂囊里把食物磨碎。它们可以很长一段时间不吃不喝。

Female emus mate multiple times in a season, laying 5 to 15 beautiful dark-emerald eggs (one every few days) before continuing on in search of other mates. The males take their parental role seriously, guarding the nest (which may house eggs from different females) and barely eating or drinking until the chicks hatch about 8 weeks later. The males then care for the young until the next breeding season.

雌鸸鹋在一个繁殖季里会多次交配，产下 5 到 15 枚漂亮的深祖母绿色蛋（每隔几天下一枚），然后继续去寻找其他配偶。雄鸸鹋则认真承担起育儿责任：守护鸟巢（里面可能住着不同雌鸟下的蛋），几乎不吃不喝，直到大约 8 周后雏鸟破壳。之后雄鸟会继续照料幼鸟，直到下一个繁殖季。

Many of the animals on O’Reilly covers are endangered; all of them are important to the world.

O’Reilly 封面上的许多动物都属于濒危物种；它们中的每一种，对这个世界都很重要。

The cover illustration is by José Marzan Jr., based on an antique line engraving from Johnson’s Natural History. The series design is by Edie Freedman, Ellie Volckhausen, and Karen Montgomery. The cover fonts are Gilroy Semibold and Guardian Sans. The text font is Adobe Minion Pro; the heading font is Adobe Myriad Condensed; and the code font is Dalton Maag’s Ubuntu Mono.

封面插图由 José Marzan Jr. 绘制，基于《Johnson’s Natural History》中的一幅古董线刻版画。丛书装帧设计由 Edie Freedman、Ellie Volckhausen 和 Karen Montgomery 完成。封面字体为 Gilroy Semibold 与 Guardian Sans。正文字体为 Adobe Minion Pro；标题字体为 Adobe Myriad Condensed；代码字体为 Dalton Maag 出品的 Ubuntu Mono。
